thesis: Agent orchestration will commoditize; the durable business is proving which autonomous actions were authorized, what happened, and whether humans can safely stop reviewing them.
doctrine: Route every autonomous action through the smallest authorized execution path that emits a terminal, evidence-backed receipt tied to a revenue-relevant outcome.
proof_artifact: Ship a canonical execution-receipt schema that records authorization_source, action_outcome, blocker_classification, evidence, and revenue_link for commitment-to-closure work.
proof_next_action: Extend the existing receipt owner in core/work_lifecycle.py with the five execution-receipt fields and add focused tests for completed, failed, and hard-blocked actions.
public_angle: The agent economy does not need another supervisor dashboard. It needs receipts strong enough that a human can stop supervising.
buyer_offer: Sell a Delegation Check that traces one production AI workflow, exposes actions lacking authority or outcome proof, and converts qualified teams into the $400 Workflow Control Map.
